A booking journey for [[Accessible seating]]: eligible members see held-back wheelchair spaces and get a free companion ticket in the same basket.

## Checkpoints

- 2026-04-15: screen reader testing passed (WCAG 2.2 AA).
- 2026-05-20: live for all clubs.
